# Francisco Moreno — Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Full-stack software engineer based in Houston, TX. 6 years building production systems for Disney, Royal Caribbean, United Airlines, and more — Angular frontends, .NET and Node.js APIs, PostgreSQL. Currently building a .NET 10 API for OXXO at Valtre. Available for freelance projects and full-time opportunities in the US.

## About

Francisco Moreno is a full-stack software engineer with expertise in Angular, TypeScript, React, Astro, .NET and Node.js. He delivered enterprise-grade products at Globant for Fortune 500 companies including Disney, Royal Caribbean, United Airlines, Dick's Sporting Goods, and Gannett, and currently builds a .NET 10 API for OXXO at Valtre with an AI-assisted, quality-first workflow. Based in Houston, TX, originally from Monterrey, Mexico.

## Skills & Expertise

- Angular (specialist), TypeScript, RxJS, Angular Signals
- React, Next.js, Astro
- Backend: .NET 10 / C#, Node.js (Fastify, Express), PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, REST APIs
- Frontend architecture: Clean Architecture, Atomic Design, Hexagonal Architecture
- Performance optimization, Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse 100
- Tailwind CSS, SCSS, CSS-in-JS
- Testing: Jest, Cypress, Playwright
- Quality & DevOps: automated testing (Vitest, Playwright), CI with GitHub Actions, Docker
- AI-assisted development: Claude Code, SDD workflow, MCP servers

## Work Experience

- **Valtre** (current) — DevCrossQA (backend). Building a .NET 10 API for OXXO with an AI-assisted workflow (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex), owning code quality and testing.
- **Globant** (5 years) — Senior Software Engineer. Clients: Disney, Royal Caribbean, United Airlines, Dick's Sporting Goods, Gannett
- **Freelance & Independent**: Regio Labs (client — AI WhatsApp bots & website), Vaneybr Portfolio (Angular), Caro Sweet MUA (brand & booking site), Nox Coffee (motion-driven brand experience, WIP)
